posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
In the interest of finding the unlock (since I haven't managed ot get it for either steam or phone yet):

Things that we know: It requires KNYFE to be in the party.  Environment is the Block. It revolves around eliminating Agents. 

Things that we suspect: Several of her ongoings/equipments must be in play.  

 

Things that might delay/invalidate the attempt

1. It is possible that if KNYFE kills the Warden, the attempt is invalidated. 

2. It is possible that if KNYFE uses "Overdo it" the attempt is invalidated. (as far as I can tell, everyone who has unlocked it did so while "Overdo it" was never played)

3. It might be necessary for "Lock Down" to be in play at least some of the time when KNYFE kills agents- she's getting in and taking them out even when everything is on full alert.

I gotta say, I like this unlock.  I was worried when people were reporting the whole "with all her stuff out", because I hate unlocks with those conditions.  However, the unlock itself is fairly simple, and the fact that Warden Waffle (his name at our table) invalidates it is an interesting twist; hard to discover, but not hard to perform, nice.

Btw, for my final unlock, I think an optimal team-up is:

Ambuscade vs. RC Wraith, AA, Granpda Legacy, Haka, and KNYFE (obviously) in the Block

RC Wraith performs a function similar to Dark Visionary, but she actually speeds up the environment, allowing you to (with assistance) play 3 extra cards a turn, which KNYFE can easily clean up with an Amplified Combatant or Incidental Contact.  Haka can Savage Mana the inmates (and Waffle) and cloaking device away to streamline the whole thing.  I got it super fast using this combo.

Good lord, do I wish there was a way to remove Prison Riot from the deck.

I've been playing for two hours and that card has brought the Environment deck to empty three times. I think I've seen three agents, maybe. When it's not a Prison Riot, it's DR or Lockdown.
